Root cause: 5 rows (1 features.id=1, 4 backlog_items.id=1..4) had `updated_at` stored as SQLite TEXT form 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' instead of RFC3339 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.nnnnnn+00:00'. row_to_feature (features.rs:36-87) and row_to_backlog_item (backlog.rs:71) call .parse::<chrono::DateTime<Utc>>() which fails, wrapped as FromSqlConversionFailure(7|10, Type::Text, ...). storage_hygiene_2026-10-18-gecko.root_cause: 5 rows in features+backlog_items had `updated_at` stored as SQLite TEXT form 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' instead of RFC3339. row_to_feature (features.rs:36-87) and row_to_backlog_item (backlog.rs:71) call .parse::<chrono::DateTime<Utc>>() which fails, wrapped as FromSqlConversionFailure(7|10, Type::Text). The 'premature end of input' wording is rusqlite's framing of the chrono parse error.
fix_applied: UPDATE features SET updated_at = created_at WHERE id = 1 AND updated_at NOT GLOB '*T*';
UPDATE backlog_items SET updated_at = created_at WHERE updated_at NOT LIKE '%T%' OR length(updated_at) < 19;
storage_hygiene_2026-10-18-gecko.code_path_recommendation: The same UPDATE path is the source. Recommend B.x follow-up: grep the codebase for `UPDATE ... SET updated_at = ?` bindings that pass a non-RFC3339 string (e.g. CURRENT_TIMESTAMP or strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', 'now')). All 5 corrupt rows were last-touched at 2026-08-07 ~10:43 — same minute, same dev session, suggesting a single bug in a date-binding helper.

bx_source_findings_2026-10-18-newt.durable_fix_recommendation:
No Rust source line to change. The corruption is already gone (gecko dispatch 2026-10-18T09:46:39Z UPDATE'd the 5 rows). The durable fix is:
1. `git rm --cached .agileplus/agileplus.db` to untrack
2. Confirm `.agileplus/*.db` is in `.gitignore` (currently `.agileplus/` is in .gitignore but does not retroactively untrack the already-tracked DB)
3. Add `.githooks/pre-commit-validate-timestamps` that uses sqlite3 to scan any staged .agileplus/*.db for non-RFC3339 updated_at rows and rejects the commit
4. Wire via `core.hooksPath` or as a lefthook/local hook
5. Open 1 PR
